core_claim: Machine intelligence is represented by verified capability-resource developmental profiles over declared ecology families; known architectures are resource-bounded realizations/factorizations of task-relative sufficient developmental states.

obligation.rule: No intelligence claim is representation-independent of all task/evaluation/resource choices.

developmental_situation.reason: External history alone need not determine future behavior/development when hidden optimizer, memory, random-state, posterior, replay-buffer or structural state differs.

abstract_state.name: developmental_sufficient_state
abstract_state.definition: Equivalence class of developmental situations that induce identical registered future verified outcome, machine-development and resource distributions under every admissible future intervention/programme.
abstract_state.not_claimed: physical or uniquely smallest cognitive atom
abstract_state.computability_boundary: The exact semantic quotient need not be constructible; practical systems may use approximate/belief/predictive-state representations.

meaning.Theta: mutable parameters, rules, memory, beliefs or configuration
meaning.kappa: semantics/compiler map into the registered obligation

intelligence_profile.reachable_set: A_M(E|d) = {(Q,B): reachable under legal development from developmental situation d}
intelligence_profile.scalarization_rule: A scalar score requires a prospectively declared ecology measure and capability/resource utility.

development_levels.K1: cognition/search capital: inherited developmental state changes future cognition-generation before fresh target success and lowers verified burden
development_levels.K2: developmental capital: inherited state lowers the burden of acquiring new K1
development_levels.K3: improvement/morphogenesis capital: inherited state improves the process that discovers/improves future cognition or morphologies
